claim: At identical measured ports and native box contracts, test whether up to 8 real scalar rows shared by all sources strictly improve amplitude or structure exclusion under exact vacuum and unknown weak background. Exact trace compression should preserve the C certificate only.

operators.discretization: 2D scalar TM pulse cell, equal-area circular integration and analytic self term; exact stored binary64 G,S,B
operators.receiver_angle: 12 equally spaced positions over 180 degrees, endpoint excluded, start -90 degrees
operators.power_gram: identity on acquisition dictionary by assigned incident port amplitudes

templates: filled patch with center cell 12 held inactive in both branches
cohort.scope: same spatial texture per amplitude pair, times a distinct amplitude; paired background identical outside the active region. Each pair independently randomized in template orientation, reference amplitude and texture, and hidden deviations.

box.width_reference: inverse spectral 2-norm of G(I-diag(m)G)^(-1) restricted to active columns of branch at zero background; reference is an exact stored numeric design scale, not a certified contraction claim
box.centers: public geometry and approximate profiles; hidden multiplicative texture jitter has absolute active deviation <=0.20 times the smaller branch reference width
box.amplitude_bands: lower peak uniform [0.65,2.2]; upper peak uniform [3.3,7.5]; structure peaks independently uniform [1.8,5.2]

measurements.noise: secret isotropic complex direction at norm 1.5% of clean response, same direction over background conditions per target; deterministic exact-stored radius 1.5001% of clean response norm
measurements.public_shape_data: two anonymized box slots, generating branch hidden; all legal methods receive same G,S,B,Y,r,ell,u
measurements.secret_seed: 128-bit OS randomness generated only after P0 and preregistration

limits.B_matrix_search: scalar spatial multipliers and optical equalities, I and exact signed Hadamard source directions, independently optimized per direction, actual PSD dual certificates
limits.shared_wall_budget: per-node 10 seconds per algorithm including strict replay, exclusive of reusable setup; each algorithm also has deterministic caps to expose practical exhaustion

metrics: truth incorporation and first generating box coverage
strict wrong-box exclusions grouped by independent pair
end-to-end times plus online/strict split and amortization
sealed reproducibility with replay from original inputs
gate: Generate no blind arrays and run no blind decisions until results/p0.json pass. Freeze public+secret acquisition bundle digests before decisions. Efficiency costs are direct measurements; scientific results refer only to this stored discrete cohort.
historical_controls: Read archived v4 low disk and v5 strong ring as exposed historical controls, compare actual supports from arrays. Their native data/observation differ from the 25-cell prospective gate.
